\[
N(p) =
\begin{cases}
M(p) & M(p) \ge M(p + d_{\theta}) \text{ and } M(p) \ge M(p - d_{\theta}) \\
0 & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(M\): The Sobel magnitude
- \(d_{\theta}\): The step to the neighbor along the rounded gradient direction

M is the Sobel magnitude and theta the gradient direction. The step d_theta goes to the neighbor along the gradient, rounded to horizontal, vertical or one of the two diagonals. The sector borders are at 22.5, 67.5, 112.5 and 157.5 degrees. A pixel survives only if it is at least as strong as both neighbors across the edge, so each edge keeps its ridge line. The greater-or-equal test keeps both pixels of a flat-topped ridge.
